<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="44" width="390" height="548" fill="#F4F8FF"/>
  
  <!-- iOS status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="27" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="316" y1="24" x2="321" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="24" x2="326" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="24" x2="331" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="343" cy="20" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="343" cy="20" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="356" y="14" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="358" y="16" width="15" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="377" y="18" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- quiet top label -->
  <text x="195" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#1877F2">YOUR DAILY BRIEF</text>

  <!-- centered news logo panel -->
  <g>
    <rect x="37" y="137" width="316" height="176" rx="12" fill="#DCEBFF" opacity=".55"/>
    <rect x="54" y="153" width="282" height="142" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".82"/>
    
    <!-- logo mark, geometric newspaper -->
    <rect x="112" y="177" width="62" height="76" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <rect x="122" y="187" width="42" height="7" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="122" y="201" width="17" height="22" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="145" y="201" width="19" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="145" y="211" width="19" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="122" y="231" width="42" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="122" y="242" width="30" height="5" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    
    <!-- blue editorial rays -->
    <path d="M95 180 L104 174 L108 181 L99 187 Z" fill="#1877F2" opacity=".72"/>
    <path d="M88 207 L100 204 L102 211 L90 214 Z" fill="#1877F2" opacity=".52"/>
    <path d="M94 238 L105 233 L108 240 L98 246 Z" fill="#1877F2" opacity=".65"/>
    <path d="M286 180 L277 174 L273 181 L282 187 Z" fill="#1877F2" opacity=".72"/>
    <path d="M293 207 L281 204 L279 211 L291 214 Z" fill="#1877F2" opacity=".52"/>
    <path d="M287 238 L276 233 L273 240 L283 246 Z" fill="#1877F2" opacity=".65"/>
    <path d="M183 167 C192 157 203 157 212 167" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M183 266 C192 276 203 276 212 266" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="30" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">news</text>
  <text x="195" y="385" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">Stay informed. Stay curious.</text>

  <!-- topic chips -->
  <g>
    <rect x="48" y="428" width="92" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DCE7F6"/>
    <text x="94" y="450" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#4E4B66">World</text>
    <rect x="149" y="428" width="92" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DCE7F6"/>
    <text x="195" y="450" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#4E4B66">Business</text>
    <rect x="250" y="428" width="92" height="34" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DCE7F6"/>
    <text x="296" y="450" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#4E4B66">Culture</text>
  </g>

  <!-- onboarding copy and action -->
  <text x="195" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#050505">Everything that matters.</text>
  <text x="195" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">Personalized stories, trusted sources,</text>
  <text x="195" y="557" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#4E4B66">and a clearer view of the world.</text>

  <g>
    <rect x="153" y="584" width="85" height="50" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity=".10"/>
    <rect x="153" y="582" width="85" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195.5" y="613" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".12px" fill="#FFFFFF">Begin</text>
  </g>

  <!-- pagination -->
  <circle cx="180" cy="665" r="7" fill="#1877F2"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="665" r="7" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
  <circle cx="210" cy="665" r="7" fill="#A0A3BD"/>

  <line x1="24" y1="704" x2="366" y2="704" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="24" y="735" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Trusted by curious readers</text>
  <text x="366" y="735" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">4.8 ★</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Explore -->
    <circle cx="48" cy="789" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="48,783 51,789 48,795 45,789" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="48" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Explore</text>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="135,784 145,776 155,784" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="138" y="783" width="14" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="145" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Home</text>
    
    <!-- Bookmark -->
    <rect x="227" y="777" width="14" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="227,795 234,790 241,795" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="234" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Saved</text>
    
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="330" cy="783" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="330" cy="794" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="330" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#667080">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
